description_en: You can call the DescribeAccelerator operation to query information about a specified Global Accelerator instance
description_zh: 调用DescribeAccelerator接口查询指定的全球加速实例信息
name: DescribeAccelerator

parameters.help_en: The region where the Global Accelerator instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所属的地域，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Global Accelerator instance that you want to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的全球加速实例ID
parameters.name: accelerator_id
